intro.title: Floral art, a story of passion
intro.description: From her studio on the French Riviera, Laëtitia Schaeffer envisions and crafts unique floral creations. Every project is an encounter, every bouquet tells a story. With Boticia, your events come alive through flowers.

creations.title: Discover our floral universe
creations.subtitle: Every project is unique. Browse our work by category and find inspiration for your event.

weddings.title: Wedding florist · bespoke floral decoration
weddings.intro: From our first meeting to the day-of installation, we design bespoke floral decorations that elevate your wedding. No fixed packages · you freely choose the services that matter to you.
weddings.step_1_desc: A conversation to understand your style, tastes, and vision for the big day.
weddings.step_2_desc: A moodboard, floral palette, and detailed quote adapted to your budget.
weddings.step_3_desc: We craft and install every creation with care at your reception venue.
weddings.cta_title: Ready to imagine your floral wedding?
weddings.cta_desc: Tell us about your project and we will design a floral decoration that is uniquely yours.
weddings.services_title: Every floral detail, designed for you
weddings.services_intro: From personal flowers to grand installations, every element is handpicked and handcrafted with seasonal French flowers.
weddings.service_bouquet_desc: The centrepiece of your outfit, your bridal bouquet is custom-made to match your dress, theme and personality. Round, cascading, bohemian or minimal · every style is possible.
weddings.service_ceremony_desc: Floral arch, petal aisle, altar compositions. We transform your ceremony venue · civil, religious or symbolic · into a unique green setting.
weddings.service_reception_desc: Table centrepieces, garlands, hanging florals, buffet décor. Every table and space is dressed to create a cohesive, immersive atmosphere.
weddings.service_accessories_desc: Boutonnieres, flower crowns, combs, bracelets. Delicate creations for the bride, groom, best men and bridesmaids.
weddings.why_title: A wedding florist who understands you
weddings.why_1_desc: We work exclusively with local growers in short supply chains. Your arrangements are fresh, sustainable and eco-responsible.
weddings.why_2_desc: From the first meeting to installation on the day, you have a single point of contact who knows your project inside out.
weddings.why_3_desc: Follow your project in real time: collaborative moodboard, detailed proposals and streamlined communication in your private space.
weddings.why_4_desc: Based on the French Riviera, we serve the entire PACA region and travel throughout France for your wedding.
weddings.faq_1_q: What budget should I plan for wedding floral decoration?
weddings.faq_1_a: The budget varies depending on the project scope. For an intimate wedding (bouquet + boutonnieres + centrepieces), expect from €800. For a complete decoration with arch, installations and accessories, the budget is typically between €2,000 and €5,000. We tailor every proposal to your budget.
weddings.faq_2_q: How far in advance should I book?
weddings.faq_2_a: We recommend contacting us 8 to 12 months before your wedding, especially during peak season (May to September). For weekday or off-season weddings, 4 to 6 months is sufficient.
weddings.faq_3_a: Absolutely. We work with you to identify varieties that match your vision. Some flowers are seasonal · we will suggest the best alternatives if your favourite isn't available on your wedding date.
weddings.faq_4_q: Do you work outside the French Riviera?
weddings.faq_4_a: Yes, we travel throughout France. Travel fees apply beyond the PACA region. Contact us for a personalised quote including transport and installation.

events.title: Event florist · floral scenography
events.intro: Floral scenography for your professional and private events. We transform your spaces into unique visual experiences through flowers.
events.service_1_desc: Complete artistic direction for your parties, launches, and galas. Floral creations that reflect your identity.
events.service_2_desc: Transform your offices, storefronts, and reception areas into inspiring spaces with bespoke floral arrangements.
events.service_3_desc: A pop-up floral space at your events where guests leave with their own creation.
events.service_4_desc: Floral design for your editorial, photographic, and artistic projects. From concept to completion.
events.philosophy_title: Emotion at the heart of every creation
events.philosophy_p1: As a floral designer, our goal is to create captivating visual experiences through floral art. We stage the theme of your project · photoshoot, set design or editorial · to reflect your identity and universe.
events.philosophy_p2: We use flowers as a means of expression through floral scenography. Delicate creations, floral sculptures, ephemeral installations: above all, we want to convey emotion.
events.gallery_desc: Each floral arrangement is designed to reflect your vision and add a unique touch to your events and professional spaces.
events.cta_desc: Describe your project and we will design the floral scenography that leaves a lasting impression.
events.why_1_desc: Every project benefits from a unique artistic direction, designed to reflect your identity and elevate your event.
events.why_2_desc: We work exclusively with flowers grown in France, sourced locally for unmatched freshness and quality.
events.why_3_desc: A single point of contact guides you from concept to installation, ensuring seamless coordination on the day.
events.why_4_desc: We handle the full logistics: delivery, installation, and collection of materials after your event.
events.faq_1_q: How far in advance should I book floral scenography?
events.faq_1_a: We recommend getting in touch at least 4 to 6 weeks before your event. For large-scale projects (galas, launches), 2 to 3 months is ideal to refine every detail.
events.faq_2_q: Do you offer services for businesses?
events.faq_2_a: Yes, we work with businesses on corporate events: seminars, product launches, gala evenings, office and storefront decoration. We also offer regular floral subscription services.
events.faq_3_a: Absolutely. We create floral installations both indoors and outdoors: gardens, terraces, castle courtyards, private beaches. We adapt our designs to the venue constraints.
events.faq_4_a: It all starts with a conversation about your project. We then present a moodboard and detailed quote. Once approved, we design and install your floral decor on the day of the event.

workshops.title: A creative moment with flowers
workshops.intro: Discover floral art in a hands-on workshop led by Laetitia. Leave with your own creation and a smile.
workshops.type_1_desc: Learn to arrange a bouquet with fresh seasonal flowers, grown in France.
workshops.type_2_desc: Create a decorative dried flower wreath to hang in your home for years to come.
workshops.type_3_desc: Compose a lasting, poetic arrangement with carefully selected dried flowers.
workshops.audience_desc: Whether it's team bonding, celebrating with friends or marking a special occasion, our workshops adapt to your wishes.
workshops.audience_teambuilding_desc: Strengthen team bonds through a creative and friendly floral activity.
workshops.audience_evjf_desc: A unique moment with friends to celebrate the bride-to-be by creating together.
workshops.audience_birthday_desc: Gift an original and memorable experience for a birthday celebration.
workshops.audience_private_desc: A bespoke workshop for your receptions, family gatherings or intimate moments.
workshops.cta_desc: Get in touch to organise a bespoke workshop for your group.

features.title: Floral art at the service of your emotions
features.feature_1_description: We prioritize locally grown French flowers for unmatched freshness and a reduced environmental footprint.
features.feature_2_description: Every arrangement is unique, designed and handcrafted to match your vision, theme and venue.
features.feature_3_description: Sustainable practices at every step: seasonal flowers, zero synthetic floral foam, reusable supports.

pricing.title: All-inclusive packages for your wedding
pricing.plan_2_summary: Bridal bouquet, boutonnieres, table centrepieces, welcome sign and venue visit included. Everything you need for a complete and harmonious floral decoration.
pricing.plan_3_summary: Complete artistic direction, bespoke scenography, setup and day-of coordination. For those who dream of an exceptional floral event.

alacarte.title: Design your wedding floral decoration
alacarte.subtitle: Freely choose the services that suit you, with no package commitment. Each element is personalised to your wishes.
alacarte.cta_hint: Describe your project and we will send you a tailored quote.

process.title: Three steps to your floral decoration
process.step_1_description: We discuss your project, your wishes and your world during a free, no-obligation first meeting.
process.step_2_description: We design a bespoke proposal with a moodboard, a floral palette and a detailed quote tailored to your budget.
process.step_3_description: Our team carefully installs each arrangement to enhance your venue and create the atmosphere you've been dreaming of.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about our floral services.
faq.q1: How far in advance should I book?
faq.a1: We recommend reaching out 6 to 12 months before your event, especially for weddings during peak season (May to September).
faq.q2: Do you only use French flowers?
faq.a2: We prioritize seasonal French flowers sourced locally. Depending on your wishes, we can thoughtfully incorporate select imported varieties.
faq.a3: Yes, we travel across all of France for your events. Travel fees may apply depending on the distance.
faq.q4: How does a first consultation work?
faq.a4: Get in touch by email or phone. We discuss your project, your wishes and your budget during a free, no-obligation first meeting.
faq.q5: Where and how are the creations made?
faq.a5: All compositions are assembled to order in our workshop on the French Riviera, with the utmost care.
faq.q6: How long do dried flower bouquets last?
faq.a6: Dried flowers stay intact for several months, even years, as long as they are kept away from direct sunlight and moisture.
faq.a7: Yes, Boticia supports you throughout your wedding with bespoke floral creations: bouquets, arches, centrepieces and much more.
faq.q8: Can you create custom floral decorations for events?
faq.a8: Every event is a bespoke service tailored to your needs: floral scenography, flower corners, suspended installations.
faq.q9: How should I care for dried flower arrangements?
faq.a9: Keep your bouquets away from direct sunlight and avoid humidity, draughts and heat sources to preserve their beauty.
faq.q10: What types of workshops do you offer?
faq.a10: We offer bouquet composition, flower wreath, terrarium and seasonal creation workshops, for all levels and occasions.
faq.cta_title: Have a question not listed here?
faq.cta_desc: Get in touch directly, we'd love to help.

about.tagline: Shall we get to know each other?
about.title: About me
about.intro: I'm Laëtitia, a floral designer with a deep passion for flowers. Three years ago, I founded Boticia with one idea in mind: creating unique, modern and meaningful floral scenographies.
about.value_1: Bespoke compositions that reflect who you are
about.value_2: Locally sourced French flowers, committed and responsible
about.value_3: A caring, attentive guidance at your own pace
about.approach: I love taking the time to understand your world, to listen to you and to imagine together a floral decoration that will elevate your special day. Here, no standardised creations · every project is a true collaboration.
about.anecdote: I'm like the tortoise in the fable: I start slow, but once I get going, nothing can stop me!
about.cta_text: Dreaming of a floral scenography with style and meaning?
